verdicts.explanation: All 9 noindexed pages are the internal MSF-staff rewards/HR section (pay, benefits, staff contacts), not public content; the key public pages (home, contact-us, who-we-are) stay indexable.

The page is titled and roled as the site's contact page and explicitly commits to putting visitors in touch with an office, yet its raw HTML carries no phone or email token anywhere, only a map widget.

evidence.value: Get in touch with your nearest MSF Office

fixes.quote: Get in touch with your nearest MSF Office
site_specific: Add a visible general email address (e.g. a press or head-office contact) as plain text or a mailto: link directly on /contact-us, not only inside the interactive office map.
List at least one phone number in the page's static HTML so it survives without the map widget rendering.
